timing: Synchronized wall time. Init includes fresh quadrature setup, support search and MLA. Generation includes GPU Debye integration, all 225 source propagations, normalization, thresholding and phase-space rearrangement for 101 depths. Per-depth validation, diagnostic gather and benchmark logging are outside summed generation intervals.
startup: One MATLAB process; GPU runtime startup outside optical timers. For each parameter, all full warmups precede all formal measurements. Each run clears debye_gpu and rebuilds optical setup; normal runtime/FFT caches persist. Reuse prior numerical validation after verifying identical optical source and identical timed statements.
representation: One depth at a time remains on GPU; full 101-depth stack is not assembled or exported.
changes: Single precision on same RTX 3090 as PyTorch.
Original Debye integrand evaluated by batched Gauss-Legendre GPU quadrature, validated against original CPU adaptive integral and doubled quadrature order.
Original zero-padded shifts, Fresnel FFTs and per-call transfer-function construction retained.
Normalization reductions and phase-space index reassignment vectorized; depth order streamed.
Original square MLA, adaptive support, +1 nm depth offset and 0.005 threshold retained.
ordering: parameter 1 warmups, parameter 1 measurements, parameter 2 warmups, parameter 2 measurements
statistics: Warmup and measurement phases kept separate; mean, sample SD (ddof=1), median, min, max.
